answer: Each identity must anchor to one verified academic degree checked against its university registry, with enrolment, examination and graduation forming a thread of evidence that the holder completed the course. One degree backs one identity; a shared, purchased or forged degree merges the cluster into one weight and suspends it. A forestry graduate who studied walnut cultivation cannot lend that degree to a second account. Earning a degree per fake takes years of study, tuition and examinations, and a proven forgery ripples through the registry, revoking every identity that relied on it.
